responsibility: This file implements the generic RTL framework for discovering and postprocessing hardware-doloop candidates so targets can convert loop_end patterns into machine-specific hardware loops late in the backend. It scans CFG and dataflow information to discover loop bodies ending in loop_end-style constructs, records nesting, incoming edges, iteration-register use, jumps, asm presence, and register sets, optionally reorders blocks so loop ends follow loop headers, and then invokes target-supplied hw_doloop_hooks to optimize or reject each loop. Its responsibility is target-independent loop discovery and orchestration for hardware-loop reorganization, not the target-specific rewrite itself.
same_name_distinction: Implements the hardware-doloop framework declared in gcc/hw-doloop.h by discovering loop_end-based RTL loops, analyzing their CFG/register properties, optionally reordering blocks, and invoking target hw_doloop_hooks callbacks. The header defines the hwloop_info data layout and hook contract rather than performing loop discovery or transformation orchestration.
